svg.text: Activity reads like the coordinator chat: an avatar and byline per run of one author, turns as quiet dividers, filters by agent.

text.tspan: opens the task, files open the Workspace

svg.text: Read its brief · Updated its plan: 3 of 5 steps done

text.tspan: 3. Group rows by author; keep the byline on top of a long entry
Make Activity and Handoffs readable, like
Links first, then the bands. Keep

svg.text: Filter chips by agent: name in text and a dot.
Several can be on; ‘All’ clears them.
A long entry’s byline sticks while you read it,
then gives way to the next one.
Notes fold into one quiet line under the
Commands as in A: wrap, 3 lines, lazy colour.
A handoff names its addressee in the byline:
Handoffs read the same as Activity: one look
for both tabs and the chat.
No time rail: time moves into the byline, and running/durations into the turn dividers. At 390 wide the avatar
shrinks to 20px and the filter chips scroll sideways. Roomiest of the three: about 30% fewer rows on screen than today.
